messages.subject: Kingsmoor House - building survey report
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena,

Our building survey of Kingsmoor House is complete. Overall the building is in good condition following the 2016 refurbishment. Priority items: roof coverings nearing end of serviceable life (budget c.£120k over 3-5 years) and lift modernisation on the north core (c.£85k). Nothing that should hold up the purchase. Full report circulated separately.

David Calderbank
Calderbank Vine
